title: I Am Reading News Written by AI
excerpt: I built an AI news automation system, then realized that I had become its most devoted reader. A personal essay about AI slop, authorship, and responsibility.
seo_desc: A personal account of running an AI-written news system and thinking through authorship, AI slop, and responsibility.

title: Did AI Build the World's Strongest Gomoku Engine? Not Until We Read the Logs
excerpt: A one-hour AI-built Minimax engine appeared to beat Rapfi 3–0. Log analysis found disabled NNUE weights and a ghost-stone timeout bug. After the fixes, Rapfi won 5–0.
seo_desc: A practical AI debugging story: suspiciously perfect Gomoku results exposed an evaluation environment bug, a file-format mistake, and a ghost-stone timeout bug.

title: StockPulse Self-Improvement Experiment — 2026-08-21 (Success)
excerpt: The LLM forecast matched the KOSPI direction and target zone. The ML ensemble failed, and both results produced concrete prompt and feature changes.
seo_desc: An English translation of the StockPulse 2026-08-21 forecast evaluation, including the successful LLM run, failed ML run, and applied improvement actions.

title: StockPulse Self-Improvement Experiment — 2026-08-25 (Failure)
excerpt: The forecast focused on an early selloff but missed the final upward direction. The failure led to prompt changes for intraday volatility, rebounds, and V-shaped reversals.
seo_desc: An English translation of the StockPulse 2026-08-25 failure analysis, including LLM and ML evaluation results and the applied improvement actions.

title: Ornith-1.5 Server Quality and Real-Use Speed Benchmark
excerpt: Ornith-1.5 Q5_K_M, Q6_K, and Q8_0 were measured on a DGX Spark GB10 with real YouTube production prompts, structured-output validation, retry convergence, and llama-server timings.
seo_desc: A reproducible Ornith-1.5 Q5/Q6/Q8 benchmark on DGX Spark GB10 using real production prompts, validator retries, serving speed, TTFT, and MTP acceptance.

title: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 MTP GGUF — Local GB10 Test
excerpt: A local measurement and deployment record for Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 MTP GGUF on DGX Spark GB10, including throughput, acceptance, long-serving behavior, and a single-prompt demo.
seo_desc: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 MTP GGUF measured on NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10: 680–930 t/s prefill, 17–19.5 t/s decode, 93.1% MTP acceptance, and long-serving results.

title: Wiki Embedding Search — A Local Hybrid Search Design
excerpt: A local semantic-search system for the wiki using sqlite-vec, BGE-M3, bge-reranker-v2-m3, keyword search, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
seo_desc: A local hybrid wiki search design and PoC using sqlite-vec, BGE-M3, reranking, keyword retrieval, RRF, and ARM64 measurements.
